title: Why Kratos had to kill Baldur in God of War
subject: baldur
description:
Was Kratos right to kill Baldur? 👇

How Baldur's last fight ended, and the winter it started. Spoilers for God of War (2018).

Fan-made content. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Santa Monica Studio or Sony Interactive Entertainment. Game images © their respective owners.

scenes.text: Kratos spared Baldur's life. Seconds later, Baldur had Freya by the throat.
Free of the spell, he could feel the cold again, and the pain, and he laughed.
"You had no right, witch!" he screamed at her for the spell.
Kratos had just told him, "The cycle ends here. We must be better than this."
Then he snapped Baldur's neck to save Freya, and she swore revenge on him for it.
Baldur's death started Fimbulwinter, three years of winter before Ragnarok.
